# v1.5.2 — Release notes from the repo are now used as the Release body

> **zread-pi 1.5.2**: CI used to build every Release body from GitHub's auto-generated changelog,
> silently ignoring `.github/release-notes/<tag>.md`. The workflow now resolves the notes file with a
> shell check and passes it through `body_path` — the four affected Releases (v1.4.0 / v1.4.1 / v1.5.0 /
> v1.5.1) were backfilled from the files committed at those tags.

## 🐛 Root cause

The `release` job used a one-liner expression:

```yaml
body_path: ${{ hashFiles(format('.github/release-notes/{0}.md', github.ref_name)) != '' && format(...) || '' }}
```

When `hashFiles(...)` returns an empty string, the expression falls through to `''` — and GitHub Actions
**drops empty inputs** from a step's `with:` block. The action therefore never received `body_path`,
so `generate_release_notes: true` won every time. Evidence: the run log for `v1.5.1` lists only
`files` / `generate_release_notes` / `overwrite_files` / `token` in the `with:` group, and the published
bodies were the 78-character `**Full Changelog**` line for every release since v1.4.0.

## 🔧 Fix

| Step | What it does |
|---|---|
| `actions/checkout@v5` in the `release` job | the notes file must exist on disk (the job does no build work, so checkout is cheap) |
| `Resolve release notes body` (`id: notes`) | `if [ -f ".github/release-notes/${GITHUB_REF_NAME}.md" ]` → writes `body_path=<file>` or an empty value to `$GITHUB_OUTPUT` |
| `Create Release` | `body_path: ${{ steps.notes.outputs.body_path }}` |

No match still falls back to `generate_release_notes`, exactly as documented.
The pitfall is written into both the workflow comments and `AGENTS.md` §4.5 so it is not reintroduced.

## 📝 Historical backfill

`v1.4.0`, `v1.4.1`, `v1.5.0`, `v1.5.1` Release bodies were replaced with the notes files committed at
those tags (`gh release edit --notes-file`). Tags and build artifacts are untouched; the bodies were
verified to match the committed files line-for-line.

## 📦 Install

```bash
# Option 1: standalone binary (zip attached to this release, unzip and run)
#   zread-pi-v1.5.2-windows-x64.zip / linux-x64 / macos-arm64

# Option 2: from source
bun install
bun run vendor:build
bun run cli --dir <target-repo>
```

## ✅ Verification

- `bun run typecheck`: 0 errors (workflow + docs only)
- Workflow assertions: key fragments present, no active `hashFiles` reference, no tab indentation
- Backfill check: v1.4.0 / v1.4.1 / v1.5.0 / v1.5.1 bodies are byte-identical to their committed notes files
- This release itself is the end-to-end proof: its body comes from this file

# v1.5.2 —— Release 正文改用仓库内发布说明

> **zread-pi 1.5.2**：CI 此前一直用 GitHub 自动生成的变更列表当 Release 正文，静默忽略了仓库里的
> `.github/release-notes/<tag>.md`。现在 workflow 用 shell 判断文件是否存在并通过 `body_path` 下发；
> 受影响的 v1.4.0 / v1.4.1 / v1.5.0 / v1.5.1 已用各自 tag 上的说明文件回填。

## 🐛 根因

`release` job 原来用一行表达式：

```yaml
body_path: ${{ hashFiles(format('.github/release-notes/{0}.md', github.ref_name)) != '' && format(...) || '' }}
```

`hashFiles(...)` 返回空字符串时，表达式回路到 `''`，而 GitHub Actions 在处理 step 的 `with:` 时
**会丢弃空值输入** —— action 根本没收到 `body_path`，于是 `generate_release_notes: true` 每次生效。
证据：v1.5.1 的运行日志里 `with:` 只有 `files` / `generate_release_notes` / `overwrite_files` / `token`；
自 v1.4.0 起每个 Release 的正文都是 78 字符的 `**Full Changelog**` 单行。

## 🔧 修法

| 步骤 | 作用 |
|---|---|
| `release` job 新增 `actions/checkout@v5` | 说明文件必须在磁盘上（该 job 不跑构建，checkout 成本很低） |
| 新增 `Resolve release notes body`（`id: notes`） | `if [ -f ".github/release-notes/${GITHUB_REF_NAME}.md" ]` → 向 `$GITHUB_OUTPUT` 写 `body_path=<file>` 或空值 |
| `Create Release` | `body_path: ${{ steps.notes.outputs.body_path }}` |

未命中时仍回落到 `generate_release_notes`，与文档一致。该坑同时写进 workflow 注释与
`AGENTS.md` §4.5，避免后人重新引入。

## 📝 历史回填

v1.4.0 / v1.4.1 / v1.5.0 / v1.5.1 的 Release 正文已替换为各自 tag 上的说明文件
（`gh release edit --notes-file`）。tag 与构建产物未动；正文与提交文件逐行核对为一致。

## 📦 安装

```bash
# 方式一：standalone 二进制（本 Release 附带的 zip，解压即用）
#   zread-pi-v1.5.2-windows-x64.zip / linux-x64 / macos-arm64

# 方式二：从源码运行
bun install
bun run vendor:build
bun run cli --dir <目标仓库>
```

## ✅ 验证

- `bun run typecheck`：0 错误（仅 workflow 与文档改动）
- workflow 片段断言：关键片段齐备、`hashFiles` 已无活动引用、无 tab 缩进
- 回填核对：v1.4.0 / v1.4.1 / v1.5.0 / v1.5.1 正文与仓库内说明文件逐行一致
- 本 Release 自身即端到端验证：正文来自本文件
